rows.label: What the project is
rows.value: San Juan Conservation Land Bank plans to develop a multimodal recreational trail from John O. Linde Community Park, through the Beaverton Marsh Preserve, and to the terminus of Halvorsen Road for benefit of the people of San Juan County. A new boardwalk will be designed and constructed to cross a Category I wetland that separates the east and west sides of the preserve. Short sections of new trail will be constructed to connect existing trails with the boardwalk. Portions of existing gravel trails will be widened and surfaced with gravel to match existing conditions. Directional, regulatory, and informational signs and related interpretive elements will be installed.
